Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From eac6a3639decefcc8eb0941dd3cebe79993670ad Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Maxime Ripard <maxime.ripard@free-electrons.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Dec 2017 16:58:59 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: sun8i: a711: Reinstate the PMIC compatible

When we added the regulator support in commit 90c5d7cdae64 ("ARM: dts:
sun8i: a711: Add regulator support"), we also dropped the PMIC's
compatible. Since it's not in the PMIC DTSI, unlike most other PMIC
DTSI, it obviously wasn't probing anymore.

Re-add it so that everything works again.

Fixes: 90c5d7cdae64 ("ARM: dts: sun8i: a711: Add regulator support")
Reviewed-by: Chen-Yu Tsai <wens@csie.org>
Signed-off-by: Maxime Ripard <maxime.ripard@free-electrons.com>

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/sun8i-a83t-tbs-a711.dts b/arch/arm/boot/dts/sun8i-a83t-tbs-a711.dts
index 98715538932f..a021ee6da396 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/sun8i-a83t-tbs-a711.dts
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/sun8i-a83t-tbs-a711.dts
@@ -146,6 +146,7 @@ &r_rsb {
 	status = "okay";
 
 	axp81x: pmic@3a3 {
+		compatible = "x-powers,axp813";
 		reg = <0x3a3>;
 		interrupt-parent = <&r_intc>;
 		interrupts = <0 IRQ_TYPE_LEVEL_LOW>;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm/boot/dts/sun8i-a83t-tbs-a711.dts`**
   - A new line was added to the device tree source (DTS) file to reinstate the PMIC (Power Management Integrated Circuit) compatible string. Specifically, the line `compatible = "x-powers,axp813";` was added under the `pmic@3a3` node.

### Relationships

- The modification in the DTS file addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (90c5d7cdae64) where the PMIC's compatible string was removed when regulator support was added. By reinstating the compatible string, the PMIC can be properly probed, restoring functionality that was lost due to the earlier change. This patch effectively fixes the issue caused by the previous commit.
